facebook._comment: Copy this file to platforms.json and fill in your tokens. Get tokens from Graph API Explorer (developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer) → exchange short-lived user token for long-lived, then fetch page access_token (does not expire). See SETUP.md for details.

x._comment: developer.x.com → Project/App → Keys and tokens. Needs OAuth 1.0a user context (api_key/api_secret = Consumer Keys, access_token/access_secret = Access Token and Secret with Read+Write permission). Free tier = 500 posts/month.

line._comment: LINE Developers Console (developers.line.biz) → your Provider → Messaging API channel → Messaging API tab → issue a long-lived Channel access token.

discord._comment: Discord channel → Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL (looks like https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...).

instagram._comment: Requires an Instagram Business/Creator account linked to a Facebook Page. Get ig_user_id via GET /{page_id}?fields=instagram_business_account using the FB page token. access_token can reuse the FB page access_token above as long as it has the instagram_content_publish permission.

tiktok._comment: Phase 3 stub — not yet implemented. TikTok Content Posting API requires app audit approval from developers.tiktok.com before it can publish outside sandbox/private testers.

youtube._comment: Phase 3 stub — not yet implemented. YouTube Data API v3 via Google Cloud Console OAuth2 client (console.cloud.google.com) — needs client_id/client_secret from an OAuth client + a refresh_token obtained via the OAuth consent flow with youtube.upload scope.
